summary: Completed backend (pytest) + frontend (Playwright) testing of Bali Vision Tour app. All 22 backend tests passed covering public content GET (tours=9, cars=6, activities=9, articles=7), slug lookup, auth login/me/wrong-pw/401-without-token, admin CRUD for all 4 resources (create+GET verify+update+delete), bookings public create + admin list/patch/invalid-status/delete, admin stats (counts, 14-day daily), image upload (PNG upload+serve, non-image 400, auth required). Frontend flows verified: preloader detaches, hero-title visible, 8 tour-card-* on home, tour detail page loads, book-tour-btn opens booking-dialog, booking form submits and new booking persists in DB (verified via GET /api/bookings), WhatsApp URL generated correctly (window.open). Admin login: wrong pw shows login-error, correct redirects to /admin with admin-dashboard and all stat cards. Admin tours page shows resource-table with 9 rows and correct edit-{slug}/delete-{slug} testids. Bookings admin page lists bookings with booking-status-{id} selects. Logout returns to /admin/login; unauthed /admin redirects to login. Mobile viewport (390x844) shows mobile-nav and centered logo.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix Tabs switching via programmatic .click() does not always mount the target tab's fields (e.g. field-price under tab-pricing-&-media). Real user clicks work (screenshot confirms tab visible), but automated tab clicks may not trigger a Radix state change reliably. Consider using onValueChange controlled state or defaultValue that mounts all field-price inputs. Not user-blocking, but hurts testability.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:110 sets cookie samesite='none' + secure=true - correct for cross-site preview URL; fine.
server.py:157 slug lookup does OR on slug/id - good fallback but with 12-hex ids there is a tiny collision risk if a slug matches a hex-only string; low priority.
server.py:367 seed logic auto-updates admin password only if 'password_changed' flag absent - good idempotent seed per playbook.
server.py:314 upload accepts jpg/png/webp/gif and enforces 8MB - good.
server.py has no rate limit on public /api/bookings POST - low priority but could be abused; consider throttle.
server.py stores hardcoded WhatsApp number in frontend BookingDialog; if you want to make it configurable move to backend /api/config.
seed_data_creation: Created test bookings and test tour item during flow tests; test tour deleted after verification. Two TEST_ bookings remain in DB (created via UI and API) — cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Public site uses preloader (~1s) — wait for [data-testid=preloader] to detach. Booking dialog on tour detail: click [data-testid=book-tour-btn], fill booking-name/booking-phone, click booking-date, then click button[name=day]:not([disabled]), press Escape to close popover before clicking booking-submit (otherwise popover intercepts). WhatsApp opens via window.open — stub it as `window.open = (u)=>{window.__lastOpen=u;return null}` to capture URL. For admin CRUD via UI, Radix Tabs (tab-pricing-&-media etc.) need real user click, not JS .click(); use `page.get_by_role('tab', name='Pricing & Media').click()` instead.
